scope: Native libxkbcommon buffer compiler source and EI inventory/map-bound special-key planner. Windows tests inject C functions and use actual ctypes symbol buffers; Linux native parser did not run. No EI input or application-outcome proof.

scoped_tests.current_source_coverage: Initial46 pass/2 failed fixture nodes, then2 exact failures pass and180 callers pass on r2. Current r3 changes only XkbCompiler.close and its BusinessError import, AST comparison retained; final5 nodes cover uncertain release, both compiler cancellation paths, normal integrated close and cancelled owner close. No whole-group rerun or full suite.

initial_failure.cause: Two test fixtures replaced initial ASCII x with the same x, leaving map bytes unchanged. Corrected only to a different byte !; runtime hash guard and assertions preserved.

close_followup.change: Finished task alone is not clean after portal_xkb_cleanup_pending. Retain original task/exception and connection owner; do not retry ambiguous void unref.

compiler_contract.load: Lazy Linux-only fixed libxkbcommon.so.0 C ABI; unavailable library/missing required symbol fails explicitly. No installation or default-layout fallback. Pointer-sized opaque handles, uint32 state/keycodes, size_t buffer length and pointer-to-symbol-pointer signatures declared.
compiler_contract.compile: Received bounded keymap body/size/SHA/terminator checked. Compile buffer as XKB text v1 with flags0, context flags NO_DEFAULT_INCLUDES|NO_ENVIRONMENT_NAMES and cleared include paths. Never use names/RMLVO/new-from-file/default keymap. Context/keymap/state disposed in order even on failure.
compiler_contract.meaning: Existing11 special keys only, Enter uses XKB Return keysym name. Bounded current zero-state map rows must have exactly one single-symbol candidate; no fixed US keycode. Simulate down/up in private xkb_state, require no reported component changes and all serialized modifiers/layouts stay0 with same symbol. Documented evdev-compatible XKB convention subtracts8, extended range bounded to Linux keycode domain.
compiler_contract.limits: This is library key-symbol and logical-state interpretation, not proof of every server action, compositor shortcut/grab, physical release, target focus or app handling. Native parser acceptance/ABI execution still need Linux evidence. Extended text/chords/groups remain separate development.
compiler_contract.ownership: Original executor Future and shielded compile task retain native work until actual return/cleanup on caller or actual-task cancellation. Pending close keeps EI connection; ambiguous cleanup remains pending without duplicate unref.

planner_contract.before: Exact chosen EI device/seat, active keyboard interface, done/resumed/not destroyed, keymap and neutral modifier tuple; capture whole immutable inventory and body hash.
planner_contract.after: Recheck full inventory/epochs and body after real compile and before returning immutable KeyboardPlan. Verify again before use; state/map drift, pause/resume or failed read latches old plan invalid. One internal plan per current connection, no input API, permit or worker business connection added.
planner_contract.body_binding: EisDevices stores actual reader per device and verifies actual retained body size/SHA before exposing internal bytes, rather than trusting metadata alone.

publication: Local-only checkpoint. Specific remote transmission authorization remains pending; no push or alternative upload.
